purpose.description: Expectations models the anticipated state trajectory of a system under analysis — the 'expected path' against which the Drift Sentinel measures actual regime migration. It supplies nominal trajectory envelopes (upper bound, lower bound, central tendency) calibrated from historical patterns, domain-specific baselines, and declared targets. These envelopes are consumed by the Drift Overlay to establish baseline deviation thresholds (ΔM floor) and to contextualise Drift Report readings within the DDR.
